The primary purpose of this role is to enhance efficiency, productivity, and cost-effectiveness while ensuring the highest quality standards in ductwork projects   Benefits   Career growth and professional development. Collaborative and supportive team environment. Analysing workforce utilisation, facility layout, operational data and production schedules and costs to determine optimum worker and equipment efficiencies.  Developing specifications for manufacture, and determining materials, equipment, piping, material flows, capacities and layout of plant and systems  Organising and managing project labour and the delivery of materials, plant, and equipment  Establishing standards and policies for installation, modification, quality control, testing, inspection, and maintenance according to engineering principles and safety regulations  Inspecting plant to ensure optimum performance is maintained  Directing the maintenance of plant buildings and equipment, and coordinating the requirements for new designs, surveys, and maintenance schedules  Ensure that safety protocols are rigorously followed, conducting risk assessments, and implementing safety measures to protect workers and the environment  Collaborating with project managers to assist in project planning and execution. Help in resource allocation, project scheduling, and identifying potential risks to meet project deadlines and budgets.    Qualification & experience   Relevant qualification at the level of a bachelor’s degree or higher, OR at least 5 years of relevant work experience, will substitute for formal qualifications.  Strong communication skills  Intermediate-level user of Microsoft Office  Continuous improvement experience and willingness to be hands-on.  Ability to multitask  Experience in personnel management   About Company    Q-TEK Mechanical Ductwork Pty Ltd is an Australian company specializing in the design, fabrication, and installation of HVAC ductwork systems for commercial and industrial projects, known for its quality workmanship, efficiency, and compliance with industry standards.
